## Birthplaces[edit]


Twenty-one states have the distinction of being the birthplace of a president.


One president's birth state is in dispute; North and South Carolina (British colonies at the time) both lay claim to Andrew Jackson, who was born in 1767 in the Waxhaw region along their common border. Jackson himself considered South Carolina as his birth state.[1]
